spec.title: How AlphaFold 3's denoiser is trained
spec.caption: AF3 SI §3.7 and §4, Eqs. 2–6 and 15, Table 6. Boltz-1, Protenix and ESMFold2 replace the printed weight's denominator (t̂ + σ_data)² with EDM's (t̂ σ_data)²; Protenix calls the printed form a typo.
spec.main_latex: \mathcal L_\text{diffusion} = \frac{\hat t^2 + \sigma_\text{data}^2}{(\hat t\,\sigma_\text{data})^2}\Big(\mathcal L_\text{MSE} + \alpha_\text{bond}\,\mathcal L_\text{bond}\Big) + \mathcal L_\text{smooth-LDDT}

steps.explanation: Noise levels for training are log-normal around 0.3 σ_data, i.e. most training happens at a few ångströms of noise.
Squared error after a weighted rigid (Kabsch) alignment of the ground truth onto the prediction; ligand atoms count ten times more than protein atoms.
Bond lengths between ligands and polymers, switched on (α_bond = 1) only in fine-tuning.
A differentiable lDDT on all atom pairs within 15 Å (30 Å for nucleic acids): rewards correct local geometry independent of global alignment.
The trunk is trained through the distogram head and through the denoiser; 48 noised copies of each structure share one trunk pass.
